summary: TransAlta Corp filed Form 6-K announcing a planned leadership change: Joel Hunter becomes President & CEO effective April 30, 2026, replacing retiring John Kousinioris. Mike Politeski is appointed EVP & CFO effective May 1, 2026, and Grant Arnold as EVP & CCO effective May 6, 2026. The press release outlines the transitions with specific effective dates and background qualifications. This is a pre-announced, orderly succession rather than a forced departure, but represents a significant management change. No deal terms are provided as it is not a transactional event. Watch for any strategic shifts under new leadership.
